prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Visual Carousel Layout: Replaces the default story layout with a visual carousel featuring pet animations to engage users at the start.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Meet Your Virtual Desktop Companion"}}
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Restoration Hint: Adds a clear hint below sign-in explaining how account restoration works for returning pet owners.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in with your original account restores your previously adopted pets automatically."}}
2: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Split Authentication Layout: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a split layout separating single-click auth from standard account login.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Sign In to Save Your Companion"}}
3: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Upload Tip Carousel Component: Adds a tip carousel component to the photo upload screen highlighting optimal lighting and camera angles.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Clear, well-lit photos of your pet front-facing yield the best 3D pet generation results.", "style": "calm"}]}}
4: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Character Card Grid Redesign: Redesigns the pick friend screen into a grid layout featuring archetype choice cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Select your companion archetype", "style": "playful"}]}}
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Progress Notification Toggle: Enables time estimates and ready notifications on the waiting screen while background assets build.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Arrival"}}
6: [home, new_flow] Desktop System Verification Flow: Inserts a new system check screen during the waiting stage to confirm display and desktop overlay permissions.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_system_check", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_system_check": {"headline": "Verifying Desktop Display", "body": "Checking screen overlay permissions so your pet can roam freely on your desktop.", "layout": "centered"}}
7: [finish, hint] Home Intro System Tray Control Hint: Adds an explicit hint on the home intro screen detailing desktop system tray shortcuts and hotkeys.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Right-click your pet on screen or use the system tray icon to access controls, hide, or interact."}}
8: [finish, new_screen] Pet Interaction Quick Reference Screen: Adds a quick reference checklist screen at the end of onboarding summarizing key desktop gestures and controls.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_interaction_guide"], "new_interaction_guide": {"headline": "Pet Interaction Quick Guide", "body": "Quick reference for summoning, hiding, and feeding your new desktop companion.", "layout": "checklist"}}
9: [choose_path, incentive] Choose Path Mascot Encouragement Badge: Adds an animated mascot and quick-completion badge to the path selection screen.
   config: {"choose_path": {"components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:welcoming_pet", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "badge", "text": "Takes less than 2 minutes", "style": "highlight"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesign retains pet introduction role in story screen.
Sign-in account restoration hint complies with all base rules.
Split authentication layout maintains sign-in screen functionality.
Tip carousel component adds photo upload guidance without violating rules.
Grid layout redesign retains friend selection functionality.
Progress notifications and real time estimates are permitted on waiting screen.
Inserting a new system check screen within onboarding flow is allowed.
Adding tray control hints to home intro screen complies with onboarding rules.
Adding a new guide screen following home intro is explicitly permitted.
Adding mascot and time estimate badge to choose path complies with all rules.
